what: Components that are not biological ligands: crystallisation additives, buffers, salts, detergents and lipids. A request about 'the ligand' of an entry never means one of these, and a generator never picks one as an entry's main ligand.
rule: A biological ligand is a non-polymer component of kind 'ligand' in the frozen facts whose component code is not listed here. The list is written by hand from the components of the frozen panel (data/panel/facts) plus the commonest additives of the PDB; a component is listed when the entry's primary citation treats it as part of the crystallisation or purification mix, not as a bound substrate, cofactor, inhibitor or drug.
